get_grasp_control_parameters: get force control parameters for a named object like cup to configure gripper torque and claw angle
get_cup_grasp_parameters: get the list of claw fraction open angle and max torque tuples for grasping a cup object
predict_affordance_grasp_point: predict a suitable 3D grasp point on an object using RGB image, depth map, mask, and camera intrinsics
compute_grasp_point_from_depth: compute the 3D point in gripper space from a depth image masked by an object segmentation mask
review_affordance_prediction: review the affordance_prediction function that calculates bounding box center and converts pixel coordinates to 3D grasp points
